4965 Suchar {soo-khar'}

源自希伯來文 SNH07941; 專有地名

欽定本 - Sychar 1; 1

敘加 = "酒醉的"
1) 可能是示劍城的另一個名字, 撒瑪利亞的一個城市,
   靠近雅各井 (#約4:5|)
record.edic_text:
4965 Suchar {soo-khar'}

of Hebrew origin 07941;; n pr loc

AV - Sychar 1; 1

Sychar = "drunken"
1) probably another name for the town of Shechem, a town in Samaria,
   near the well of Jacob
